Very odd experience
Jan 2024 • Family
We popped in here for dinner & felt like we'd walked into a bar in the red light district. Young scantily clad ladies everywhere hanging out by customers tables & against the bar. We got a table & a menu & 6 of them came & stood at our table, four at one end & two at another. It was very intimidating especially for the kids. I ended up asking why they were there & one replied 'to take your order'. We decided to leave as just didn't feel comfortable. I'm sure as per reviews it's a great bar but definitely not suitable for a family meal!

Enjoy Vietnam and try ro see the beauty in the differences with society at home that makes Vietnam such a great place.

Great Bar - Super Atmosphere
Apr 2023 • Couples
We were staying at the Park Hyatt, very swanky but the area isn’t really too authentic & we struggled to find somewhere to have a few drinks that wasn’t a bit pretentious. 
Went for a walk & stumbled across this pub, 
So friendly & welcoming! Super atmosphere. The girls all so lovely & really made a huge effort to chat with us in English, 
Great cocktails, nice selection of wine & beer. 
We both had some noodles & they were so tasty we went back to eat there the next evening too! 
Would definitely recommend popping in here if you’re in HCMC. Area really interesting too & was nice to meet & chat to some of the workers in the ‘Girly Bars’ opposite. Didn’t dare go in though…,😊😊

Unexpectedly Awesome night.
Mar 2019 • Friends
Stumbled upon this little gem on a quick trip to HCMC. Had Live sports on the big screen so drew us in. The drinks were cold, cheap and bar staff were very friendly and made sure we were looked after. Mix of great local menu and western choices for the fussy friend. At night you get the awesome view out of the open roof and creates a feeling of space in a busy city. We met the owners who offered some great advice and tips for the rest of our trip. We had such a great time we stayed for the music DJ and showed off some moves on the dancefloor. NB. The entry is around the side and has some stairs to navigate.
